title: Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN for Efficient Multipath Parameter Estimation in MIMO Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.13298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-resolution multipath estimation in wideband multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channels requires repeated searches over angle of arrival, angle of departure, and propagation distance. This paper presents neural network-assisted CLEAN (NN-CLEAN), which replaces the multidimensional search at each extraction step with a multi-head classifier while retaining least-squares (LS) estimation of the complex path gain, parametric reconstruction, and residual cancellation. The same classifier is applied to successive residuals, allowing the extraction depth to vary without changing its output structure. With the number of iterations prescribed by the reference multipath-component (MPC) count, off-grid synthetic tests show that NN-CLEAN slightly exceeds grid-search CLEAN (GS-CLEAN) in path accuracy for one and two MPCs, although its accuracy declines more rapidly at larger path counts. translated_abstract: 宽带多输入多输出（MIMO）信道中的高分辨率多径估计需要对到达角、离开角和传播距离进行反复搜索。本文提出神经网络辅助CLEAN（NN-CLEAN）方法，用多头分类器替代每个提取步骤中的多维搜索，同时保留复路径增益的最小二乘（LS）估计、参数化重构和残差消除。同一分类器被应用于逐次提取后的残差，使得提取深度可以变化而无需改变其输出结构。在迭代次数由参考多径分量（MPC）数目规定的情况下，离格合成测试表明，对于一径和两径MPC，NN-CLEAN在路径精度上略优于网格搜索CLEAN（GS-CLEAN），尽管其精度在更大路径数时下降更快。对于批大小为ei的三MPC完整提取（原文此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出神经网络辅助CLEAN（NN-CLEAN），用多头分类器替代传统多维搜索，在保留LS增益估计与残差消除的同时，实现了MIMO系统中更高效的多径参数估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NN-CLEAN, which replaces multidimensional searches with a multi-head classifier for efficient multipath parameter estimation in MIMO systems, while retaining LS gain estimation and residual cancellation.
